items.q: Six month old boy with recurrent bacterial pneumonias, absent tonsils and no circulating B cells has what?
o: X linked agammaglobulinaemia needing lifelong IVIG
items.exp: BTK blocks B maturation as maternal IgG fades; IVIG replaces with live vaccines banned while antibiotics bridge. SCID adds viral and fungal susceptibility with T loss.
items.kp: No B cells at 6 months: Bruton.

items.q: Adult with bronchiectasis, autoimmunity and low IgG with low IgA is which entity?
o: Common variable immunodeficiency with IVIG and autoimmunity watched
items.exp: Late onset hypogammaglobulinaemia clusters autoimmunity with granulomas; IVIG damps infections while immunosuppression balances flares. Myeloma spikes monoclonal protein.
items.kp: Adult low IgG plus autoimmunity: CVID.

items.q: Newborn screening for SCID uses which test and why urgent?
o: TREC assay catching T absence before live vaccines or BMT window
items.exp: Excision circles mark thymic output; absent TRECs trigger isolation with BMT or gene therapy before rotavirus or BCG kill. Delay wastes the curative window.
items.kp: Screen T cells at birth: TREC.

items.q: Neonate with hypocalcaemic seizures, absent thymic shadow and conotruncal heart has what?
o: DiGeorge 22q11 needing irradiated blood and calcium
items.exp: Pharyngeal pouch failure removes thymus with parathyroids; live vaccines with non irradiated transfusions threaten while cardiac repair precedes immune reconstitution. FISH confirms deletion.

items.q: Eczema with thrombocytopenia of small platelets in a boy suggests what?
o: Wiskott-Aldrich with WAS protein and BMT curative
items.exp: Cytoskeletal WAS failure smalls platelets with infections and autoimmunity; BMT cures while splenectomy debates bridge. ITP enlarges platelets.

items.q: High IgE with retained primary teeth and cold abscesses marks which defect?
o: Job hyper IgE STAT3 with antifungal and skeletal watched
items.exp: STAT3 Th17 failure invites staphylococcal cold abscesses with fractures and scoliosis; prophylaxis with vigilance outlasts while BMT debates continue. Atopy itches without abscesses.
items.kp: High IgE, kept baby teeth: Job.

items.q: DHR test is used to diagnose which phagocyte defect with catalase positive infections?
o: Chronic granulomatous disease with NADPH oxidase failure
items.exp: Absent respiratory burst spares catalase negative organisms (they donate peroxide) while Aspergillus and Staph thrive; prophylactic cotrimoxazole with itraconazole and interferon gamma protect. LAD delays cord.
items.kp: Catalase positive infections: test DHR for CGD.

items.q: Renal graft mottling blue minutes after anastomosis with preformed DSA is what and managed how?
o: Hyperacute rejection: remove graft, no treatment salvages
items.exp: Complement fixing DSA infarcts instantly with fibrinoid necrosis; crossmatch and PRA prevent while desensitisation suits sensitised pairs. Cellular rejection waits weeks.

items.q: Tubulitis with endotheliitis 6 weeks post transplant responds to what?
o: Pulse steroids or ATG for acute cellular rejection
items.exp: T cell tubules invasion reverses with steroids while steroid resistant cases need depleting antibodies; C4d negativity separates humoral. Levels retuned after.

items.q: Rash with profuse diarrhoea and cholestasis 40 days after BMT is which entity?
o: Acute GVHD needing steroids with calcineurin cover
items.exp: Donor T cells assault skin, gut and liver within 100 days; steroids with tacrolimus quell while CMV PCR excludes mimic. Chronic GVHD scleroses later.
items.kp: Post BMT triad under 100 days: acute GVHD.
